srs_algorithm_ready: Scheduling model is ready. Review cards have been rescheduled.
rwkv_download_help: RWKV downloads from GitHub for offline use. Reviews stay local. Switching to RWKV reschedules all languages.

srs_steps_help: Use m, h or d (minutes, hours, days): 1m 10m. Empty uses the model interval.
srs_invalid_steps: Use positive steps with m, h, or d, separated by spaces.
srs_learn_ahead_help: When the queue is empty, show learning steps this many minutes early. 0 = wait until due.
srs_display_order_help: Learning due today comes first. Random order stays fixed for the study day.
srs_limit_help: Empty = unlimited. The limit also stops new cards. Same-day learning stays available; reading ratings count.
srs_rank_help: Use frequency ranks (1 = most common), not occurrence counts. Ranks combine; unranked words use global retention.
srs_invalid_bands: Use increasing rank limits and retention from 70% to 99%.
srs_leech_help: 0 disables detection. Only Again on regular reviews counts; relearning repeats do not.
srs_reschedule_help: Active review cards in this language only. New, learning, mastered and suspended cards and review history stay unchanged.
srs_override_help: 70–99%. Empty uses frequency rules or global retention.
undo_latest_only: Only the latest answer across all tabs can be undone.
